title: Improved Friedgut coordinate bound
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\{-1,1\\}$, and let $\\epsilon,\\eta$ be real numbers with $\\epsilon>0$ and $0<\\eta\\leq1$. Let $k$ be a natural number, and suppose the total influence $I$ of the associated real-valued function is positive. Define $\\rho=\\eta/(2+\\eta)$, and include in $S$ every coordinate whose influence is at least $\\left((\\epsilon/I)\\rho^k\\right)^{1+\\eta}$. Then $|S|$ is at most $I^{2+\\eta}\\epsilon^{-(1+\\eta)}(2/\\eta+1)^{2k}$.
hypotheses_covered: The total influence of the associated real-valued function is positive
